17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 864-68 North Orleans Street, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: ©§ DX-5 Downtown Mixed-Use District
Lot Area: Approximately 7,500 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to develop the subject property with a new five-
story mixed-use building containing two (2) retail units at grade and
fourteen (14) hotel rooms on the floors above. One of the retail units will
contain approximately 1,370 sq. ft. of floor area and the second retail unit
will contain approximately 2,200 sq. ft. of floor area. The proposed building
will measure approximately 57 ft.-6 in. in height. The subject property is a
Transit Served Location and will not provide off-street parking. Pursuant to
Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and
pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the
Applicant is seeking to reduce the number of off-street parking spaces to
zero and is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as allowed by the
Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 37,500 square feet (5.0 FAR)

(B) __ The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): No residential units proposed.

© The amount of off-street parking: | Zero

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location based on its
proximity to the Chicago bus line corridor and the Chicago Brown Line CTA rail
station. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the
off-street parking to zero.

(D) _ Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: Zero
b. Side Setbacks:
North Side: zero
South Side: zero
c. Rear Setback: Zero

(E) Building Height: 57 ft.-6 in. in height
